reason: A browser-side navigation panel for DeepSeek Harness that marks conversation rows, shows hover summaries, and lets users jump through long conversations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供紧贴滚动条的对话指示面板，用于查看摘要并快速跳转到会话内容。
summaries.en: Adds a compact browser-side conversation indicator beside the scrollbar for viewing summaries and quickly jumping through long DeepSeek Harness conversations.

capabilities: Reads rendered conversation DOM elements in the browser
Displays an interactive conversation indicator panel
Provides hover summaries and smooth scrolling to conversation rows
Reads plugin preferences from browser localStorage
